sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/tikirvpark (Campspot park record, site types and prices as cached in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13; Campspot refuses plain HTTP)

values.note: Operator's 'starting at' rates (2026): Electric Only $45, Water & Electric $50, Full Hook Up $57; primitive tent sites $40. On Campspot, one night for 2 adults: October 2026 $45-57, June 2027 $48-60, Tuesday and Saturday alike. $3 per extra adult; $25 to lock a specific site number; $5 cancellation fee. Campspot adds its own booking fee (3%, at least $3).

fees.source: https://tikirvpark.com/ways-to-stay ('Starting at: $45' Electric Only, '$50' Water & Electric, '$57' Full Hook Up, '$40' Primitive; homepage 'END OUR 2026 SEASON') + https://tikirvpark.com/faqs ('$3 fee applies for each additional guest, beyond 2 adults', '$25 fee applies upon booking' for a site lock, cancellation '$5.00/reservation'), read 2026-10-22; Campspot one-night quotes for 2026-10-17/20 and 2027-06-08/12 (cached in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13)

hookups.source: https://tikirvpark.com/ways-to-stay (Electric Only, Water & Electric, Full Hook Up 'water, electric, and sewage connections') + Campspot site types (Water & Electric and Full Hook Up list '30-Amp', '50-Amp'), read 2026-10-22 / 2026-10-13

values.note: Campspot sells 60 RV sites (33 water & electric, 18 full hookup, 9 electric only) and 13 primitive tent sites; RV site types list 46-62 ft. Back-in and pull-through sites.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/tikirvpark (site types with counts and max lengths: Electric Only 9 / 46 ft, Full Hook Up 18 / 62 ft, Water & Electric 33 / 54 ft, Primitive 13 tent; cached in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13) + https://tikirvpark.com/facilities ('Pull-Through Sites', 'Back-In Sites'), read 2026-10-22. The stored 43 ft came from note prose; Campspot lists longer.

values.note: Wi-Fi at the front office only ('We do NOT guarantee WiFi to each individual site'). Dump station free to guests, $10 for others. Free shuttle to the Kewadin Casino.

facilities.source: https://tikirvpark.com/facilities ('Shower Facilities', 'separate men's and women's bathrooms', 'complimentary shuttle service to the Kewadin Casino') + https://tikirvpark.com/faqs ('We have a dump station available for free to guests ($10 for non-customers)', 'WiFi is available at the front office 24/7', 'inside the laundry room'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://tikirvpark.com/rules ('Open Seasonally April 15- November 1') + Campspot park record (closed from 2026-11-01 to 2027-04-14), read 2026-10-22 / 2026-10-13

values.note: Book on the operator's Campspot page ('Reserve Now') or call 906-643-7808. Cancel 48 hours before arrival for a refund of the deposit less $5. Late arrivals find a map with their name outside the office.

booking.source: https://www.tikirvpark.com/ ('Reserve Now' -> https://www.campspot.com/book/tikirvpark; tel:9066437808) + https://tikirvpark.com/faqs (cancellation, after-hours arrival), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://tikirvpark.com/faqs ('Tiki RV Park offers a Military/Veteran discount ... it's not applicable on holidays or weekends'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and its Campspot engine: $45 (electric only) to $57-60 (full hookup), 50-amp/water/sewer, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump, Apr 15 - Oct 31 season, military discount, booked on Campspot (/book/tikirvpark). Changed max_rig_ft 43 -> 62 (Campspot's longest site type; 43 came from note prose). Added WiFi (office only) and booking details. No mandatory per-night fees. Note left as written ('over 100 sites' is the old figure; Campspot sells 73).
flags: Second website link is the Campspot marketplace slug https://www.campspot.com/park/tiki-rv-park-campground; the operator's own booking link (its 'Reserve Now') is https://www.campspot.com/book/tikirvpark.
Price gate: base $45 (Oct 2026) / $48 (June 2027) is under US$50 anyway; Mackinac (Mackinaw City) gateway is 12 km away. Never stayed.
